policy: This file is a research concordance, not a DSS transcription. Passage ranges are inventory-reported coverage and do not imply that every word in the cited range is extant. No DJD fragment number, IAA imaging-plate number, column/line, or textual reading is asserted unless individually verified. Preliminary inventory data must be checked against published editions and current institutional catalogues before textual comparison.

field_guide.inventory_reference: Photographic inventory or museum plate identifier; not automatically a DJD fragment number.
field_guide.djd_reference: Discoveries in the Judaean Desert volume and fragment designation; null until verified.
field_guide.iaa_identifier: IAA catalogue identifier; null until directly correlated.
field_guide.passage_coverage: Scriptural passage ranges reported by the cited inventory; exact surviving wording and completeness require edition-level inspection.
field_guide.condition: Extant status of the precise passage; use unknown when not established.
